family: R8-N neutral: volume-cap fills (k x bar volume) tren majority_1x frozen (Nautilus idea thu hai)
hypothesis: Engine ohlc-v2 gia dinh thanh khoan vo han: gia CHAM entry_limit la khop full size o gia limit. Stress thuc te hon (y tuong NautilusTrader): moi bar chi khop toi da k x volume cua bar vao lenh (mo phong thanh khoan huu han + queue). Neu qty lenh > k x volume cua bar cham gia thi bo bar do (unfilled) va thu bar ke tiep trong expiry 12-bar (second-chance giong probfill). Muc tieu la do survival/robustness cua majority_1x, KHONG phai tang loi nhuan.
volume_unit: base BTC per 5m bar (quote_volume chi de tham chieu; taker_buy_volume ton tai nhung khong dung)
branch_count_note: 4 branches (k) x 2 scenarios (normal, fee_stress) = 8 o danh gia. Day DA la stress nen khong chay exec-stress.
control: majority_k100 (k=1.0 bypass volcap) normal phai khop published majority_1x (+165.17829563633% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.09% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) hoac STOP
volcap_formula: Voi tin hieu co limit L, direction d, duyet expiry bars idx=signal_index+1..signal_index+12 theo thu tu: cand=engine._entry_fill(bar,d,L); neu cand None -> bo (no-touch). Neu k>=1.0 -> fill ngay tai cand (control bypass, bit-identical engine). Neu k<1.0: notional=equity_hien_tai*leverage(1x); qty=notional/cand; cap=k*float(bar[volume_column]); neu qty<=cap -> fill tai cand; nguoc lai coi nhu unfilled o bar do (volcap_skip+1) va thu bar ke tiep trong expiry. Khong khop mot phan, khong doi gia entry. Quyet dinh chi dung bar hien tai + equity qua khu (causal), tru luu y: full-bar volume ve ly thuyet chi biet sau khi bar dong (intrabar look-ahead nhe, ap dung dong nhat).
rng_scheme: Deterministic, khong co draw ngau nhien. seed_base=1729 chi ghi de dam bao sap xep/tai lap co dinh danh (signals sort by bar_index, candles sort by open_time). Moi branch chay lai tu dau voi cung thu tu (cong bang so sanh).
monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) theo parent_plan (giong v15/v30); monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1.
engine_note: Phan con lai cua backtest (stop/timeout market-like o scenario fee, TP1 50% + TP2, funding long 0.0001/8h short 0, stop-first intrabar, TP suppression tren intrabar entry candle, drawdown trade-candle-close sampled, compounding tu equity hien tai, overlap next_available_index, holding validation, truncated-window reject) GIU NGUYEN nhu engine ohlc-v2 run_backtest. Chi khoi entry-search duoc chen them dieu kien volcap. k=1.0 bypass de lam control gate bit-identical.
verdict_note: Day la thang robustness (do survival khi k giam), KHONG phai gate loi nhuan. k la gia dinh stress chu quan, khong suy ra tu microstructure/queue that. Khong claim maker fill probability tu OHLC. Capital indexed 100, 1x co dinh: ket luan chi co hieu luc o quy mo nay, khong suy rong cho capital lon hon nhieu.
